entities.summary: The Cathedral-Basilica of Our Crowned Mother of Palmar is a basilica church in El Palmar de Troya, Spain. The church, dedicated to the Virgin Mary under the title of Our Lady of Palmar, serves as the only cathedral and 'mother church' for the Palmarian Catholic Church, a schismatic independent Catholic denomination not in communion with Rome.
